Our story

Festive wear that lets little ones be little

Clothes for running across lawns, spinning until dizzy and falling asleep in the car on the way home.

The atelier

Made in small numbers, in Shahpur Jat

Blush Tiny Blossoms makes festive wear for children aged two to sixteen. Every piece is cut and finished at our atelier in Shahpur Jat, New Delhi, in limited numbers, so each look stays a little rare.

We start with soft cotton, because a child who is comfortable is a child who is happy. Then come the things that make it festive: hand-block florals, fine kinari gota, mirror work and resham embroidery.

What we care about

Three things, every piece

Soft first

100% cotton bases that sit gently on young skin, through a long evening of celebrations.

Made to move

A relaxed fit, side-seam pockets in the shararas and tiers that are cut to twirl. Nothing stiff, nothing scratchy.

Handwork that shows

Gota, sequin and resham handwork, placed where it catches the light and kept away from where it would bother.

Festive ’26 · collection notes

The English Garden Edit

“We wanted Diwali to feel like a picnic in an English garden. Gingham laid on grass, flowers tucked in hair.”

For Festive 2026 we reimagined our atelier favourites, peplums, shararas and palazzos, in a soft garden palette. Checks in lavender, peony pink and ecru become the canvas. They are sun-washed, never stark, and printed over with oversized monstera, hibiscus and daffodil.

Gingham baseLavender, blush and mustard checks
Tropical botanicalMonstera, hibiscus, daffodil
Tiered shararaTwo and three tier flare, made to twirl
Gota + mirrorFine kinari, triangle gota, shisha
Peplum silhouetteStrappy, ruffle-sleeve, tie-up
Sustainable cottonHandloom, azo-free dyes
